---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```

The Bond films in this dataset go from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

```{python}
#| echo: true

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Global revenue (millions)")
plt.show()
```
